name: Calder
title: Purveyor of Provenance
examine: A pleasant face you will struggle to describe afterward. His counter is spotless. His ledgers do not exist.
lines: Everything on this counter has a history. None of it is written down. That's the service.
Runa stamps silver. I un-stamp it. The mountain provides for everyone.
You didn't find this place. The alley let you in. There's a difference, and Pike keeps track of it.
